generic_name: Hand-Held Rubber Bulb Nebulizer (Manual Atomizer Device)
purpose: This is a small hand-held device used to spray liquid medicine directly into your nose, throat, or mouth as a fine mist. It is commonly used to deliver nasal sprays, throat medications, or certain liquid treatments. Squeezing the rubber bulb creates a puff of air that turns the liquid medicine into a mist you can breathe in or that coats the area being treated.
how_it_works: When you squeeze the soft rubber bulb, it pushes a burst of air through a small tube that sits in the liquid medicine. This air movement breaks the liquid into tiny droplets, creating a fine mist or spray. The mist is directed toward the target area, like your nose or throat, so the medicine can be absorbed right where it is needed.
common_side_effects: The device itself does not cause side effects, but the medicine you put inside it might. Always check with your pharmacist or doctor about side effects of the specific medication you are using in this nebulizer.
warnings: Keep this device very clean — rinse and dry it after every use to prevent germs or mold from growing inside. Never share your nebulizer with another person. Do not use damaged or cracked bulbs. Only use medications that your doctor or pharmacist has approved for this device.
typical_dosing: Follow your doctor or pharmacist's instructions for how many squeezes or puffs to use and how often. The dose depends on the medicine being used, not the device itself.
